# Review Python code

Review python code:

##  Checklist
- [ ] Bare except clauses
- [ ] Missing type hints
- [ ] Unclear variable names



## Output Format
Provide results as:
- ✅ PASS: Items of checklists that look good
- ⚠️ WARN: Items of checklists that could be improved
- ❌ FAIL: Items of checklists that must be fixed before merge
